title: River rhythm
description: Blue curves move across a warm, quiet ground. A single orange circle interrupts their rhythm, inviting your eye to slow down and find its own path.
detail: Follow one blue curve with your eyes. Where does it lead you? This original Unframe illustration is part of the simulated QUT visit, not a QUT collection work.
source: Unframe studio · Original illustration for a simulated QUT visit
chineseIntroduction: 《河流的韵律》，Unframe studio，2026年。蓝色曲线在温暖、宁静的底色上流动，一枚橙色圆形打破了节奏。沿着一条曲线慢慢看，它把你的目光带向哪里？这是用于模拟参观的原创插画，并非QUT真实馆藏。

title: Soft architecture
description: A sequence of terracotta arches frames a small, still sphere. Repeated shapes turn a familiar doorway into an imagined space between architecture and sculpture.
detail: Imagine stepping through these arches. How would this space feel? This original Unframe illustration is part of the simulated QUT visit, not a QUT collection work.
source: Unframe studio · Original illustration for a simulated QUT visit
chineseIntroduction: 《柔软的建筑》，Unframe studio，2026年。陶土色拱门围绕一枚安静的球体延伸，重复的几何形状构成介于建筑与雕塑之间的想象空间。如果走进拱门，你会有什么感受？这是用于模拟参观的原创插画，并非QUT真实馆藏。

title: Between places
description: Layered greens and a winding line suggest a landscape remembered rather than mapped. The open spaces leave room for a place of your own.
detail: Which shape reminds you of somewhere you have been? This original Unframe illustration is part of the simulated QUT visit, not a QUT collection work.
source: Unframe studio · Original illustration for a simulated QUT visit
chineseIntroduction: 《场所之间》，Unframe studio，2026年。层叠的绿色和蜿蜒的线条勾勒出记忆中的风景，留白邀请你放入自己的回忆。哪个形状让你想起曾经去过的地方？这是用于模拟参观的原创插画，并非QUT真实馆藏。
